content:
BUILT CoLAB co-organises, together with the SECClasS project team and the National BIM Standardisation Technical Committee (CT197), the working meeting to present the “Construction Classification System – tools to support use and review”, which takes place online on 10 February, between 16:00 and 17:00.

This workshop aims to present the SECClasS construction classification system, indicate where it can be downloaded and searched, present tools to support its use and start the revision process. It is mainly addressed to all those interested in the use of classification systems in BIM software, or those who want to know more about the subject.

Participation is free of charge, but subject to registration here.

SECClasS (Sustainability Enhanced Construction Classification System) is an EEA Grants funded project that aims to facilitate Circular Economy in Construction by introducing a Sustainability Optimised Construction Information Classification System.
